ja: • 電子戦用アーマーを特能装備とするヴァルヴレイヴの６号機が登場。

• 扇状の武器「ファン・タロン」はクリアパーツ製。
• 戦場を支配する特殊武器「ハミング・バード」が付属。

en: • Valvrave Unit 6, which has electronic warfare armor as special equipment, has appeared.
• The Senses Nerve "Shinra Bansho" that covers the whole body is reproduced with clear parts.
• The fan-shaped weapon "Fan Talon" is made of clear parts.
• Comes with a special weapon "Humming Bird" that dominates the battlefield.
Molded product x 18, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
